title: I2 Event
description: Event sent by the vision service: an emergency vehicle, a stalled vehicle or an accident. Written to the Redis stream atlas:events (System Architecture, I2); in deployment Option B the same message is sent with POST /events. One event per tracked vehicle: the same event_id is used while the vehicle stays in view.

event_id.description: Id of the event. Stays the same for the same track, so that repeated messages do not raise new alerts (D3). A new track_id gets a new event_id; repeated alarms for the same place are suppressed in the vision service.

track_id.description: Id of the vehicle track in the vision service (stage S1), written as <run>-<tracker id>, where <run> is the UTC start time of the vision service (for example 20261126T090000Z-42), so that an id is not reused after a restart. The id is not stable: a vehicle can get a new id after an occlusion or glare, so one vehicle can arrive with several track_ids. Needed for the next-camera match (FR-13, NFR-19).

vehicle_type.description: Type of emergency vehicle (FR-08). null for stalled vehicles and accidents.

ts.description: UTC time of the camera frame that confirmed the event (technical meeting of 21.11.2026). Not the time the message was sent.

speed.description: Estimated speed of the vehicle in km/h (FR-05). null if it could not be estimated.

direction.description: Direction of travel in degrees, clockwise from north (0 = north, 90 = east), estimated with the camera homography (FR-05). null if unknown.

confidence.description: Confidence of the vision service in the event, from 0 to 1. For an emergency vehicle it is the mean classifier score over the track (S4PT-52). For stalled vehicles and accidents null if the rule gives no score.

beacon_confidence.description: Confidence that the beacons are active, from 0 to 1 (FR-07, FR-08). null while beacon detection (FR-07) is not implemented, and always null for stalled vehicles and accidents.

lanes.description: Lanes affected by a stalled vehicle or an accident (FR-11, FR-12). Empty for an emergency vehicle.

snapshot_id.description: Id of the blurred snapshot stored for the event (FR-08, FR-42). null if no snapshot is stored, so that storing it does not delay the event.
